shots.subject: devendra
shots.camera: from the ditch bank outside the passenger door, slightly low, static

shots.subject: suman

shots.subject: suman

shots.subject: suman
shots.camera: from the ditch bank, slightly low, handheld

shots.subject: suman

shots.subject: boy

shots.subject: boy

shots.subject: devendra

shots.action: Devendra climbs out of the driver's door and comes round the raised tail of the pickup onto the road side behind Suman, one hand on the bonnet; Suman kneeling near centre with the boy before her, hand in hand
